'''Bertrin''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He argued with [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Sarell]] over how the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] use of toxic fumes should be delt with.<ref name="TORF:STF" />
